The purpose of this data ingest pipeline to in take GISAID sequences and metadata files for santizing, de-duplicating and fomatting to input into a standard Nextstrain 8 segment and concatenated genome build pipeline.

```{shell}
conda activate flu
```

## Activate
```{shell}
#| eval: false
python fludb/scripts/fludb_initiate.py
```

# Data Ingest 
```{shell}
# ibv victoria (vic)
seqkit rmdup -n source/gisaid_vic_sequences.fasta > source/gisaid_vic_sequences.rmdup.fasta
seqkit grep -s -r -i -p "^[ATCGatcg]+$" source/gisaid_vic_sequences.rmdup.fasta > source/gisaid_vic_sequences.rmdupn.noambig.fasta
```

# Run nextclade on all segments and extract clades, glycosylation and qc metrics 

For each segment (pb2, pb1, pa, ha, np, na, mp, ns):

1. Run Nextclade
Generates nextclade.tsv from segment FASTA files using the appropriate Nextclade dataset.

2. Extract Key Fields
From each segment’s nextclade.tsv, extract:
qc.overallScore, qc.overallStatus, coverage → renamed with segment prefix (e.g., pb2_qc.overallScore)
For ha: also extract clade, subclade, and glycosylation
For na: also extract glycosylation

3. Merge Segment QC into a Genome Table
Combines all segment-level QC and annotation into a single table.
Computes:
    genome_qc.overallScore → average of all segment scores
    genome_qc.overallStatus → semicolon-delimited string of statuses (e.g., pb2:good;pa:bad;...)

4. Update Metadata Files
    Merges relevant QC fields into each segment’s and the genome’s metadata.tsv
    Uses sample_ID (from metadata) matched to seqName (from Nextclade)
    Saves enriched files as metadata_qc.tsv

output: 
- nextclade.tsv per segment
- Merged genome_qc_summary.tsv
- QC-enriched metadata_qc.tsv for each segment and genome

```{shell}
python scripts/nextclade_segment_qc.py
```

new output metadata for each segment is `metadata_qc.tsv`

# Downsampling from the HA dataset (since now we have everything we need to downsample in the ha dataset)

1. Expand the `location` column in HA metadata. - we'll focus on region and country.
2. de-duplicate the metadata file by the sample_ID (this will automatically filter out any fasta entry not present in the metadata)
3. de-duplicate the nextclade file by the sample_ID (this will automatically filter out any fasta entry not present in the metadata)
4. Left join HA nextclade result file with fludb metadata file 
5. Enrich C.3s by Downsample gisaid HA for C.3 sequences - obtain fasta headers 
6. Downsample all non-C.3 gisaid isolates
7. Extract all high genome quality JHH Isolates
8. Final representative strains for each segment - ingest into data/ folder
9. Drop Clade and Subclade columns for final filtering
10. Loop through all segments and the genome dataset to extract curated + downsampled sequences

## 1. Expand the `location` column in HA metadata. - we'll focus on region and country. 

LOOP - Function to extract region, country, and division from an original location column

```{shell}
# we dont need the loop for now but wrote it just in case...
python scripts/loop_format-location.py
```

resulting file is source/intermediate/vic/ha/metadata_qc_location.tsv

## 2. de-duplicate the metadata file by the sample_ID (this will automatically filter out any fasta entry not present in the metadata)

```{shell}
python scripts/dedup.py \
    -i source/intermediate/vic/ha/metadata_qc_location.tsv \
    -o source/intermediate/vic/ha/metadata_qc_location_dedup.tsv \
    -d logs/metadata_duplicates.tsv \
    --drop-all-duplicates \
    -c "sample_ID"
```

# 3. de-duplicate the nextclade file by the sample_ID (this will automatically filter out any fasta entry not present in the metadata)

```{shell}
python scripts/dedup.py \
    -i source/intermediate/vic/ha/nextclade.tsv \
    -o source/intermediate/vic/ha/nextclade_dedup.tsv \
    -d logs/metadata_duplicates.tsv \
    --drop-all-duplicates \
    -c "seqName"
```

## 4. Left join HA nextclade result file with fludb metadata file 

We'll now stick with just curating the HA sequence metadata 

```{shell}
csvtk -t join -f "sample_ID;seqName" \
    source/intermediate/vic/ha/metadata_qc_location_dedup.tsv \
    <(csvtk -t cut -f seqName,clade,subclade source/intermediate/vic/ha/nextclade_dedup.tsv) \
    --left-join \
    > source/intermediate/vic/ha/metadata_qc_location_clades_dedup_clades.tsv

```

## 5. SKIP Enrich C.3s by Downsample gisaid HA for C.3 sequences - obtain fasta headers 

result: gisaid (non JHH) downsample of all C.3s with high quality genomes. This pulls ALL C.3s assigned by nextclade into the build thereby enriching parental C.3s.

```{shell}
#    --output-strains config/vic/include_c3.tsv
```

## 6. Down-select all gisaid isolates


2025-06-28 - Update criteria to include C.3s in the augur down-selection. Remove "subclade=C.3" 

Formerly included all known C.3 HA:NA reassortments
Vaccine strains

```{shell}
augur filter \
    --metadata source/intermediate/vic/ha/metadata_qc_location_clades_dedup_clades.tsv \
    --sequences source/intermediate/vic/ha/sequences.fasta \
    --metadata-id-columns "sample_ID" \
    --exclude-where "area=Baltimore" \
    --exclude config/exclude.tsv \
    --query '(`genome_qc.overallStatus` == "pb2:good;pb1:good;pa:good;ha:good;np:good;na:good;mp:good;ns:good")' \
    --group-by week country \
    --subsample-max-sequences 3500 \
    --subsample-seed 180 \
    --output-strains config/vic/include_gisaid.tsv
```

## 7. Extract all high genome quality JHH Isolates

```{shell}
augur filter \
    --metadata source/intermediate/vic/ha/metadata_qc_location_clades_dedup_clades.tsv \
    --sequences source/intermediate/vic/ha/sequences.fasta \
    --metadata-id-columns "sample_ID" \
    --exclude-where "area!=Baltimore" \
    --exclude config/exclude.tsv \
    --query '(`genome_qc.overallStatus` == "pb2:good;pb1:good;pa:good;ha:good;np:good;na:good;mp:good;ns:good")' \
    --output-strains config/vic/include_JHH.tsv
```

## 9. Drop Clade and Subclade columns for final filtering

in: source/intermediate/vic/ha/metadata_qc_location_clades_dedup_clades.tsv
out: source/intermediate/vic/ha/metadata_final.tsv

```{shell}
csvtk cut -t -f -clade,-subclade \
    source/intermediate/vic/ha/metadata_qc_location_clades_dedup_clades.tsv \
    > source/intermediate/vic/ha/metadata_final.tsv
```

## 10. Loop through all segments and the genome dataset to extract curated + downsampled sequences
```{shell}
python scripts/curate-segments.py
```

Note because we used subclade for downsample, all metadata files have clade and subclade thus we can remove it from the segments pipeline.
